e: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

a: الرَّبُّ أَحَبَّ أَبْوَابَ صِهْيَوْنَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ مَسَاكِنِ يَعْقُوبَ.
e: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

a: قَدْ قِيلَ بِكِ أَمْجَادٌ يَا مَدِينَةَ اللهِ: سِلاَهْ.
e: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

a: «أَذْكُرُ رَهَبَ وَبَابِلَ عَارِفَتَيَّ. هُوَذَا فَلَسْطِينُ وَصُورُ مَعَ كُوشَ. هذَا وُلِدَ هُنَاكَ».
e: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

a: وَلِصِهْيَوْنَ يُقَالُ: «هذَا الإِنْسَانُ، وَهذَا الإِنْسَانُ وُلِدَ فِيهَا، وَهِيَ الْعَلِيُّ يُثَبِّتُهَا».
e: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

a: الرَّبُّ يَعُدُّ فِي كِتَابَةِ الشُّعُوبِ: «أَنَّ هذَا وُلِدَ هُنَاكَ». سِلاَهْ.
e: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
